D/ DN IOVIA NVS PF AVG

: Silver Coin. Siliqua of Jovian (363-364), Reece period 18, probably Constantinople mint. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: DN IOVIA NVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Vow in wreath: VOT / V / MVLT / X. In exergue: CONS. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.35gms, die axis: 6
